correctness.rationale: A={0} plus positive binary words having only even-length maximal zero runs, with the zero convention stated distinctly from A086747. The disjoint digit decomposition A=4A ⊔(8A+1)⊔(4A+3) is exact. Simultaneous strong induction covers every residue class, with explicit base n=2 and n=5, proving A+A=A+2A=N0. The modulo-four exclusion 2 and constructive reverse inclusions then give A+4A=N0\{n≡2 mod4}. Allowed binary words are tiled by 1 and 00; their dyadic counts F_{k+2} show density zero. Independent direct binary recognition for 20,001 values and direct sumset witnesses through 4000 passed. The finite tests do not replace mutual induction.
